title: Not for aggressive chewers
text: I bought the box for large dogs (50+ pounds) for my 15 pound terrier as a replacement for rawhide chews.  I got the box for large dogs based on the reviews.  My dog loved the chews, but the spiral one was completely gone in less than 10 minutes.  Out of curiosity I put down the large braided one, and he had eaten 2 inches of it in about 5 minutes before I picked it up.  This is not what I was looking for.
label: neutral
